title: The Horizon of Mount Kessler
author: Wren Okafor
blurb: Yara Zhou, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
